purpose: Import approved relaxed front-facing eyes and eyebrows only; preserve the rest of walk-v3.

generation.note: The raw generated proposal has incidental whole-sheet pixel drift. It is archived, not used as a full replacement.

import.operation: Copy these RGB rectangles from the generated raw sheet onto the baseline at identical coordinates, without scaling, filtering, or drawing.
